decision: Freeze protocol version 1.0 locally before computation
rationale: Prevents analysis settings from being optimized after observing reproduction results

decision: Use Pidgeon (2025) as the primary STEM reproduction
rationale: Highest-ranked verified engineering/STEM-scope candidate under the frozen prioritization rule

decision: Replace P47 s2 (Q Sort !C48) value -14 with +1 only in the normalized copy
rationale: Exactly one invalid cell exists and +1 uniquely restores the documented forced distribution

decision: Repeat the full source reproduction with P47 excluded
rationale: Required by the frozen anomaly rule

decision: Use by-person PCA, varimax rotation, and five retained factors for exact source reproduction
rationale: Matches the thesis and repository description; alternatives belong to the later robustness stage

decision: Preserve both the thesis probability text and its numerical loading rule
rationale: The thesis states p < .001 but gives 2.58/sqrt(45) = 0.384, conventionally p < .01; this discrepancy must remain visible

decision: Use Kaiser row normalization for varimax when reconstructing the reported KADE solution
rationale: The thesis identifies KADE and varimax but omits this software-default detail; Kaiser normalization reproduces all published loadings within 0.0011 whereas unnormalized varimax does not

decision: Transcribe factor arrays and distinguishing markers from thesis Figures 6.3-6.7 and Tables 6.4-6.12
rationale: All 225 array scores independently reconstruct from published loadings and primary-factor assignments

decision: Classify the Pidgeon source solution as exact numerical reproduction
rationale: Loadings meet 0.01 tolerance; rounded eigenvalues and variance match; 225/225 array scores, 47/47 primary assignments, and 29/29 distinguishing directions agree

decision: Freeze robustness addendum version 1.0 and the 1,000-seed bootstrap list before robustness computation
rationale: Fixes simulation counts, seeds, null generation, confounding margin, failure handling, and descriptive classes omitted from the parent protocol

decision: Classify the five-factor PCA and centroid solutions as fragile
rationale: Under each extraction method fewer than three factors meet all frozen leave-one-sort-out and bootstrap stability criteria; interpretability remains pending independent assessment

decision: Accept the nine Stage D outputs as deterministic
rationale: SHA-256 hashes were identical before and after an independent repeat of the full frozen robustness run
